name: Litigation Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
NH I us)
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Litigation Committee will conduct
  a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address
  the agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  4th
  Floor Conference Room A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Monday, September 16, 2024
  5:00 PM

  AGENDA
  1) Public Comment
  a) Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on
  any item not listed on the agenda

  CLOSED SESSION:

  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL The City Council finds, based on advice from
  legal counsel, that discussion in open session will prejudice the position of the local
  agency in the litigation.

  2) Existing Litigation: Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1)

  Discussion regarding Californians for Homeownership, Inc. v. City of Beverly Hills, Los
  Angeles Superior Court Case No. 24STCP02082

  This litigation concerns a challenge to the City’s determination that the application for 125-
  129 S. Linden drive was incomplete.

  3) Anticipation of Litigation: Significant exposure to litigation pursuant to Government Code
  Section 54956.9(d)(2)

  4) Adjournment

  Huma Ahmed
  City Clerk

  Posted: September 11, 2024

  Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable
  efforts to accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call
  (310) 285-1014 (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (TTY). Providing at least twenty-four (24) hours
  advance notice will help to ensure availability of services. City Hall, including the 4 Floor
  Conference Room A, is wheelchair accessible.
